body: Please acknowledge and disposition two pre-post blockers on b3f3c35 before the next candidate/gate: (1) chief/owner ruling post-01M16R78HZW78XXPEAQTEKSJ7R requires VisualChannel.SurfaceUnit, not SurfaceRail, with strengthened legend; (2) post-01M16REE8C5G4FHWFTRWRVVRFQ shows SurfaceDetailSupport case-class fromProduct can forge inconsistent capability proofs. Requested fix is a non-case final class with private ctor/public vals/value equality plus an external construction probe. F1/F2 logic otherwise passed my static review.
